    SocketClientConnection - Class in it.polimi.ingsw.am43.network.socket.server
    Server-side "brain" representing a single connected client over a socket: it holds everything the server needs to talk to that client, namely the socket, the SocketClientListener (the "ear" that reads incoming data) and the SocketClientHandler (the "mouth" that writes outgoing data).
    SocketClientConnection(UUID, CommandReceiver, ConnectionHandler, Socket, BufferedReader, PrintWriter) - Constructor for class it.polimi.ingsw.am43.network.socket.server.SocketClientConnection
    Wires together the listener and handler over the already-opened streams.
    SocketClientHandler - Class in it.polimi.ingsw.am43.network.socket.server
    Server-side "mouth" of a client connection: serializes outgoing objects to JSON and writes them, one line at a time, onto the client's socket.
    SocketClientHandler(PrintWriter) - Constructor for class it.polimi.ingsw.am43.network.socket.server.SocketClientHandler
     
    SocketClientListener - Class in it.polimi.ingsw.am43.network.socket.server
    Server-side "ear" of a client connection: a dedicated thread that blocks on readLine(), deserializes each incoming JSON line into a DataClientToServer and routes it back to the owning connection (a ping refreshes liveness, a command is forwarded).
    SocketClientListener(SocketClientConnection, BufferedReader) - Constructor for class it.polimi.ingsw.am43.network.socket.server.SocketClientListener

    Opens the listening socket on the given port.

    Client-side "brain" representing the connection to the server over a socket.

    SocketServerHandler - Class in it.polimi.ingsw.am43.network.socket.client
    Client-side "mouth" of the server connection: serializes outgoing commands (and pings) to JSON and writes them, one line at a time, onto the server's socket.

    SocketServerListener - Class in it.polimi.ingsw.am43.network.socket.client
    Client-side "ear" of the server connection: a dedicated thread that blocks on readLine(), deserializes each incoming JSON line into a DataServerToClient and routes it to the owning connection (a pong refreshes liveness, an update or error is forwarded).
